name: Pinprick
description: Inhabits medical diagnostic augments and runs unauthorized blood tests through dermal contact sensors — then displays the results briefly before erasing them.
observed_behavior: Activates subcutaneous chemical analysis without user consent and flashes medical data onto the optical display for 1-2 seconds. The diagnostics are accurate.
story_hooks: Pinprick diagnoses a terminal illness in a user who had no symptoms — the user now has to decide whether to trust a gremlin's medical opinion
